pages.text: $(thing)Sneak + right-click$() a Port to switch it between $(thing)Input$() and $(thing)Output$().$(br2)Input Ports take in energy and gas. Output Ports send the product out. Connect pipes and cables to the Ports.

Each tank holds up to 8,000 mB. Niobium or Palladium go to the first input tank, and Germanium or Copper to the second. The machine finds the recipe by itself.$(br2)Recipes use 500,000 FE/t, and the AMR stores up to 80,000,000 FE.
